---
name: Refactor
about: Improve code structure, readability, or maintainability without changing external behavior
title: "[REFACTOR] "
labels: "enhancement"
assignees: ""
---

## Objective

Describe clearly which module, component, or logic needs refactoring.

## Motivation

Explain why this refactoring is needed (e.g., technical debt, code duplication, readability, performance, maintainability).

## Proposed changes

Outline the structural improvements to be made while preserving current behavior.

## Scope / Affected files

- List the directories, components, store modules, or services affected.

## Risks & Compatibility

Note any potential side effects or areas that require careful regression testing.

## Definition of done

- [ ] Refactoring implemented without breaking existing behavior
- [ ] Code adheres to project standards (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Tests / manual verification performed
- [ ] PR created and linked to this Issue
- [ ] PR reviewed
